summary: Triple Flag Precious Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K on May 5, 2026, attaching a news release that announces a regular quarterly cash dividend of US$0.0575 per common share. The dividend is payable on June 15, 2026, to shareholders of record as of June 1, 2026. This is a routine capital allocation decision by the board and does not reflect a corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special situation. The filing contains no mention of any structural changes, third-party involvement, or strategic alternative.
